items.title: Exact live News claims — bind the newest edition and its evidence ledger to each deployment
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: pages-deploy.yml invokes check-live-news-release.mjs after News promotion, but the verifier compares pages, descriptions, icons, and art only. The canonical api/news-desk-claims.ndjson path can therefore be stale while this exact-live gate passes, which is the secondary production defect S326 found manually. Outcome: a reader or agent can trust that the newest served edition and its fact/stance ledger promoted together.
items.recipe: Extend check-live-news-release.mjs to derive the newest item from api/news-desk-feed.json, fetch its route and the NDJSON ledger from the selected content origin, require exact candidate bytes plus the newest date with at least one fact and one stance, include counts/hashes in the durable result, and add both-direction self-tests for stale, missing, malformed, and current ledgers.

L1.recipe: Fetch the candidate/live ledger and fail on byte drift.

L2.recipe: L1 plus newest-route derivation, fact/stance presence, structured receipt fields, and mutation self-tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus per-story claim coverage diagnostics and continuity comparison against the prior durable release receipt.

executionLog.note: Shared newest-edition contract validates exact feed/ledger bytes, route/date coherence, and at least one fact plus one stance.
check-live-news-release self-test passed 7/7; live exact check passed 11 pages, 33 assets, newest 2026-08-22 with five claim rows.

items.title: Dynamic staging News verifier — test the release candidate instead of August 7 fixtures
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: deploy-staging-content.mjs verifyRoutes() hard-codes two August 7 article routes and only checks the JSON Feed marker. A newly published article or claim row can fail to reach staging while the staging deploy still reports verified. Outcome: staging answers the actual release question before main is promoted.
items.recipe: Extract a pure deriveNewsReleaseProbe(feed, claims) contract, resolve the newest feed item without wall-clock assumptions, require its local route plus fact/stance rows for the same date, probe that route and the claims stream on staging, and self-test newest-item ordering, malformed feed, missing claims, and exact marker selection.

L1.recipe: Replace hard-coded article probes with the newest route from the local JSON Feed.

L2.recipe: L1 plus claim-date/fact/stance validation and self-tests for malformed or incomplete candidates.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a reusable staging release receipt consumed by the production promotion gate.

executionLog.note: Staging verifier now derives the newest route and claim rows instead of using August 7 fixtures.
deploy-staging-content self-test passed 15/15 including malformed and incomplete candidate cases.

items.title: Bounded newsroom-run receipt — show where The Desk automation last reached
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: ci-status.json knows the scheduled Desk workflow conclusion/time and news-desk.json knows the newest real edition, but /status/ exposes neither as one bounded public contract and has no named pipeline stage. Outcome: a visitor or agent can answer when the newsroom last ran, whether the evidence supports a completed rebuild, what edition is newest, and when the next daily run is expected without seeing prompts or provider payloads.
items.recipe: Build api/newsroom-run.json from the committed CI scheduled-workflow receipt, the Desk feed, and the declared workflow stage contract; emit observed/abstained states, lastRunAt, lastSuccessfulStage, latestEditionDate, nextExpectedRunAt, and privacy metadata. Bundle it into status-proof, render a /status/ tile with accessible copy, wire all publishers that change an input, add source/consumer tests, and complete CANON-053 desktop/mobile/every-theme visual QA.

L1.recipe: Publish the bounded JSON receipt and render one status tile.

L2.recipe: L1 plus abstention semantics, status-proof freshness, dependency wiring, self-tests, and every-theme visual verification.

L3.recipe: L2 plus step-level GitHub job evidence and an append-only newsroom-run history.

executionLog.note: Generated privacy-safe api/newsroom-run.json with explicit abstention from unobserved CI evidence, run-level-only stage attribution, latest edition, and next UTC slot.
Status proof, status reader, evidence graph, workflows, build order, and publisher cascades are wired and focused checks pass.

CANON-053 passed with 14/14 manually reviewed, hash-bound captures across seven themes at 1366px desktop and 390px mobile; zero blocking defects. The status shell also passed at 104ms desktop LCP and 68ms mobile LCP after its render-blocking stylesheet was removed.

items.title: Privacy qualification milestone — make the first five-pageload transition self-proving
items.why: PRE-VERIFIED: the engagement feed correctly suppresses all story reach below five and currently reports every story unavailable, but no machine-readable summary identifies whether any story has ever qualified or which receipt first proved it. The handoff therefore asks a future session to inspect this manually. Outcome: the first honest Reader views transition becomes independently discoverable without lowering the privacy floor.
items.recipe: Add a qualification summary to build-news-desk-engagement.mjs derived only from thresholded story rows: state, floor, qualifiedCount, firstQualified story/receipt/date or null, and an explicit abstention reason. Lock zero, below-floor, exactly-five, multi-story, and history-order cases with self-tests; expose the summary through the existing public feed without storing new identifiers.

L1.recipe: Add qualifiedCount and firstQualified to the public engagement feed.

L2.recipe: L1 plus receipt/date provenance, explicit abstention, and boundary/history self-tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a status-proof milestone tile that appears only after qualification and an append-only threshold-transition history.

executionLog.note: Qualification is derived only from thresholded historical reach rows; current public state honestly abstains at zero qualified stories.
Generator self-test passed 29/29, byte check passed, and public-contract health passed 89 files.
